metadata.title: Monochrome Portrait with Geometric Sans-Serif Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white studio portrait of a man in a leather jacket against a pure white background, framed by ultra-thin, wide-set geometric typography in the upper corners.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark, textured leather jacket contrasts sharply with the blown-out white background.
The hairline typography mirrors the verticality of the subject's pose.
Symmetrical placement of text blocks balances the centered subject.
coreInvariants: Pure white background with no visible horizon line

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, subject occupies the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hands gripping the lapels of the jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the hands/jacket texture, then outward to the typographic blocks in the top corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the subject and between the text blocks.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and charcoal grays in the leather jacket and hair
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin texture and highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between subject and background.

typesetting.alignment: Left and Right justified to corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both blocks to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and thin stroke profile.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and sharp vertices.
Offers a modern, clean geometric look with wide proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a man with short textured hair and a beard, wearing a dark leather jacket over a white t-shirt. He is gripping his lapels. The background is a seamless, blown-out pure white. The lighting should emphasize the texture of the leather.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two blocks of text in the top corners using an ultra-light geometric sans-serif font. The text should be all-caps, black, and positioned with significant padding from the edges.

verificationChecks: Is the font weight thin enough to appear like a hairline?
Are the text blocks balanced symmetrically in the top corners?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the 'O' characters are perfectly circular.
Ensure no color cast (sepia or blue) is present in the monochrome.
Verify the text does not touch the subject's head.
Confirm the leather jacket retains highlight detail.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key monochrome portrait + Symmetrical corner-aligned hairline geometric sans-serif.
